title_en: The announcement that the religion is completed
notes: DRAFT for scholarly review; nothing here is reviewed or published. English only: Arabic and Urdu texts are left null for translators. Written from the Quran text in content/quran (Tanzil Uthmani) in the drafter's own words; no published translation is quoted. Quran only: no hadith, no tafsir, no later tradition in the story texts. The occasions of revelation (who the persons were, what happened) are not in the verses; they appear only under unknowns and uncertainties, as later tradition, with the hadith to add later. Pronouns the Arabic leaves open are left open. Chapters are a reading order, not a chronology. Honorifics are added when the page is rendered.

claims.statement_en: The verse says that today those who disbelieved have despaired of the religion of those addressed.
Those addressed are told not to fear them but to fear God.
God says that today He has completed their religion for them, has completed His favour upon them, and has approved Islam as their religion.

chapters.summary_md: The verse says that today those who disbelieved have despaired of the religion of those addressed [c1]. They are told not to fear them but to fear God [c2]. God says that today He has completed their religion, completed His favour upon them, and approved Islam as their religion [c3].
chapters.body_md:
The verse says that today those who disbelieved have despaired of the religion of those addressed [c1]. Those addressed are told not to fear them but to fear God [c2].

God says that today He has completed their religion for them, has completed His favour upon them, and has approved Islam as their religion [c3].
chapters.deep_md: The statement has parts: what those who disbelieved have done, what those addressed are told, and what God says He has done [c1][c2][c3]. The verse says 'today' and does not give a date [c1][c3]. It does not say what was completed or in what way, only that the religion and the favour were completed [c3]. The same verse contains other matters, which this draft does not restate [c1].
chapters.kids_md: God says that today He has completed their religion for them [c3]. God says that today He has completed His favour upon them [c3]. God says that He has approved Islam as their religion, and they are told to fear God [c2][c3].
chapters.lessons_md: Educational interpretation (not scripture): One reading is that the verse sets the fear of God against the fear of those who disbelieved [c2]. Another is that it speaks of completion and favour together and puts both with God [c3].
chapters.unknowns_md:
- Not established: which day 'today' is, or where it was. The verse gives no date or place.
- Not established: what was completed or how, or what 'despaired of your religion' says about what those who disbelieved had hoped for.
- The same verse also names things made forbidden and a case of need. They are not restated in this chapter, whose subject is the announcement; a scholar should decide whether the page shows the verse whole.
- Named in later tradition, not in the Quranic text: the day, the place and the occasion of the announcement. None is used in the story texts.

uncertainties_en: Hadith to add later: authenticated reports on the day, the place and the occasion of the announcement, each with a named grader. None is used in this draft.

This chapter quotes only the announcement within 5:3 and leaves out the rest of the verse (the provisions on what is forbidden and the case of need). A scholar should decide whether partial citation of the verse is acceptable on the page.
Named in later tradition, not in the Quranic text: the day and place of the announcement.
Arabic and Urdu texts are not written; they are left null for translators.
